invariants.summary: Final Transcripts preserve spoken wording/grammar; only punctuation, whitespace, layout, context-safe symbol/format conversions, and closed labels are allowed.
Every fixture encodes one actual cloud execution branch; final is bound to that branch.
deterministic_local and non-success cloud branches require expected_final == local_baseline.
literal_identity requires selected source text == baseline == final and zero cloud requests.
Output labels are closed-set, declared, source-evidenced, and Natural-free.
Fixture tags are exactly from closed_tags; coverage matrix binds requirements to tagged fixtures.
Protected tokens are exact case-sensitive substrings of baseline and final.
Dual-provider selection uses explicit primary/rank evidence; never silent array-zero.
Delivery is unsent; auto_send, live_type, and replace_delivered are false.
Cloud is at most one request and only for disputed or clearly complex cases.
